ai_summary: Augmont Enterprises Limited reported a robust ~30% year-over-year increase in revenue for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reaching INR 189,455.85 million; however, net profit for the period significantly declined by ~15.5% to INR 608.55 million, indicating considerable pressure on operating margins. A material impact is the company's successful post-quarter IPO, raising INR 6,200 million in fresh capital, which will influence future financial strength and operations. Key red flags include this sharp decline in profitability despite revenue growth, coupled with the auditor's reliance on 'other auditors' for a substantial portion of consolidated results and the unreviewed nature of prior period comparative financial data.
